description: Oil seeds: palm nuts and kernels, whether or not broken
Vegetable oils: olive oil and its fractions, other than virgin, whether or not refined, but not chemically modified
Vegetable oils: palm oil and its fractions, crude, not chemically modified
Cocoa beans: whole or broken, raw or roasted
Sands: natural, (other than silica and quartz sands), whether or not coloured, (other than metal-bearing sands of chapter 26)
Rubber: natural (excluding latex, technically specified natural rubber and smoked sheets), in primary forms or in plates, sheets or strip
Wood: for fuel, in logs, in billets, in twigs, in faggots or similar forms, whether or not agglomerated, coniferous
Wood: for fuel, sawdust and wood waste and scrap, agglomerated in logs, briquettes, pellets or similar forms: other than wood pellets
Cement, concrete or artificial stone: prefabricated structural components for building or civil engineering, whether or not reinforced
Weighing machines: weights of all kinds, parts of weighing machinery
